jurisdiction

  • CURIE: gmeow:jurisdiction
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/jurisdiction
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/organization

The legal or regulatory jurisdiction of a specific identifier (e.g., company registration jurisdiction) — a country, state, province, or other gmeow:Location. Non-functional: different identifiers may carry different jurisdictions.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:Identifier -> gmeow:Location

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:jurisdiction from gmeow:Identifier to gmeow:Location when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:Identifier, gmeow:Location
